chore(phase2): close proxy/admin/permission/import security gaps

ClaudeQB Phase 2 (Faz2.1-2.5) security hardening:
- proxy: fix referer startsWith bypass with exact URL-origin comparison
  (api/proxy.ts) -- crafted referer prefix match no longer passes
- admin: design server-side brute-force lockout for verify_admin_password/
  admin_delete_preset as a reviewable migration (supabase/migrations/
  0001_admin_lockout_serverside.sql); not yet applied live -- needs
  Supabase dashboard access this environment doesn't have
- rpc-versioning: narrow .gitignore's blanket *.sql exclusion so
  migrations are tracked; point supabase/README.md at migrations/ as
  the forward source of truth
- mic-permission: stop requesting getUserMedia on mount in
  useAudioTracks.ts; the sidebar's existing "Grant Permission" button
  is now the only trigger
- sync-import: whitelist-sanitize .sync import shape
  (src/utils/syncImportValidation.ts) before it touches live track
  state or localStorage, so a malformed/malicious file can't inject
  unexpected fields or corrupt a track added later

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(subtitles): survive an unreadable resumable upload URL, and show why

The resumable protocol needs the x-goog-upload-url response header, and
script can only read a custom response header when the server lists it in
Access-Control-Expose-Headers. If Google does not expose it to this
origin the header reads back as null and the upload cannot start - which
surfaced only as "something went wrong". Falls back to a single-shot
uploadType=media request, which needs no response header at all.

The friendly error text also hid every cause behind one sentence, so a
failure was undiagnosable from the phone where it happened. Failures now
keep the raw message, the HTTP status and the phase that failed, behind a
collapsed disclosure with a copy button.

fix(csp): allow the browser to reach Gemini

connect-src listed only self and Supabase, so every request the Subtitle
Studio made was blocked by the browser before it left the page. It
surfaced as a bare "Failed to fetch", since a policy block looks like a
dead network from script.

This could only ever fail once deployed: vercel.json headers are applied
by Vercel, and vite dev serves without them, so local runs were never
subject to the policy.

Verified by serving the production build under both the old and the new
policy: the old one raises "connect-src blocked
https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/files" and the fetch
throws, the new one lets the request reach Google.

fix: editor robustness per review (cancel-during-edit, save validation, output sanitize)

- Cancel while editor open: worker waits with timeout + checks cancel_event, closes editor (no deadlock)
- Editor save validation: warn on block-count mismatch, require explicit 'save anyway' (prevents silent data loss)
- _sanitize_blocks before disk write: sort, drop zero/negative duration, clamp overlaps (valid SRT even after manual edits)

+def _sanitize_blocks(blocks):
+    """Diske yazmadan önce SRT bütünlüğü güvencesi (özellikle elle düzenleme sonrası):
+    başlangıca göre sırala, sıfır/negatif süreli blokları at, örtüşmeyi (overlap) kırp."""
+    clean = [[s, e, t] for (s, e, t) in blocks if e > s]
+    clean.sort(key=lambda b: b[0])
+    for i in range(len(clean) - 1):
+        if clean[i][1] > clean[i + 1][0]:
+            clean[i][1] = max(clean[i][0] + 0.001, clean[i + 1][0] - 0.001)
+    return clean
+

@@ -23,6 +23,7 @@
 import time
 import queue
 import threading
+import gc
 
 
 # --- KONSOL (CMD) PENCERESINI GIZLE ---------------------------------------
@@ -709,6 +710,14 @@ def _transcription_worker(self, video_path, srt_path, model_size,
             self.q(("progress", None))
             key = (model_size, device, compute)
             if self.model is None or self._model_key != key:
+                # VRAM tahliye protokolu: yeni modeli yuklemeden ONCE eskisini
+                # bellekten bosalt. Aksi halde dusuk VRAM'li GPU'larda (6 GB)
+                # eski + yeni model bir an icin ayni anda bellekte olur -> OOM.
+                if self.model is not None:
+                    del self.model
+                    self.model = None
+                    self._model_key = None
+                    gc.collect()
                 self._log(self.t("loading_model", model_size, device, compute))
                 self._log(self.t("first_use"))
                 self.model = WhisperModel(model_size, device=device, compute_type=compute)
